dct_description_sm:
An area of land that is of interest to the Crown as a result of an acquisition. 'Acquired land means real property where the MNRF has secured an interest in the land either directly or through an agent acting on behalf of MNRF and title is to be in the name of His Majesty the King in the Right of Ontario or a partner agency.
